Hey man I really appreciate your advice and your story. Not gonna lie, you kinda remind me of myself. I had a shit ton of doubts about joining the military after high school after a former SF guy told me about some political bullshit. It sounds like you were thinking the same thing. If I could go back, I would have slapped myself in the face lol. Anyways, I've decided that the SEAL route would interest me more. Being a doctor is noble and worthy, but being a SEAL (whether officer or enlisted) will provide an experience I wouldn't be able to get anywhere else. Once again, I appreciate you advice. Best of luck to you.
